file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of URL pattern verification results
key_content: Detailed breakdown by feature area (Dashboard, Purchase Requests, Orders, Receiving, API)
All views properly exported and resolved
Static analysis used due to missing Django runtime dependencies

file_insights.purpose: Static analysis verification script for URL pattern resolution
key_content: Extract URL patterns from urls.py using regex
Extract exports from views/__init__.py using AST parsing
Verify view functions exist in corresponding modules
Count total and purchasing-specific URL patterns

patterns_discovered.description: Used static code analysis (regex and AST parsing) instead of Django runtime commands due to missing environment dependencies
patterns_discovered.significance: Demonstrates pragmatic problem-solving when standard tools unavailable

patterns_discovered.description: Views refactored from monolithic views.py to modular structure with separate files (dashboard.py, purchase_requests.py, purchase_orders.py, receiving.py, api.py)
patterns_discovered.significance: Enables better code organization and maintainability

patterns_discovered.description: Multi-step verification process: file structure → pattern extraction → export verification → module verification → pattern counting
patterns_discovered.significance: Ensures no gaps in verification coverage

patterns_discovered.description: Hardcoded mapping dictionary matching 25 views to their corresponding module files
patterns_discovered.significance: Single source of truth for view organization

gotchas_discovered.description: Standard `python manage.py show_urls` command not available due to missing environment dependencies
gotchas_discovered.impact: Requires alternative static analysis approach instead of runtime verification
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Implemented comprehensive static analysis using regex and AST parsing

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: View Mapping Must Be Kept In Sync
gotchas_discovered.description: Hardcoded module_mapping dictionary in verification script must be manually maintained when views are added/moved
gotchas_discovered.impact: Risk of verification script becoming outdated if views structure changes
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documentation clearly shows the mapping; script could be enhanced to auto-discover modules

gotchas_discovered.description: URL patterns use `<uuid:parameter_name>` syntax that requires careful regex handling
gotchas_discovered.impact: Simple string matching insufficient for URL analysis
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Used comprehensive regex patterns to handle parameter extraction

approach_outcome.method: Static analysis using regex pattern matching and AST parsing
approach_outcome.outcome_details: All 25 URL patterns successfully verified to resolve correctly. Views properly organized across 5 modules (dashboard, purchase_requests, purchase_orders, receiving, api) with all exports correctly configured in views/__init__.py

recommendations.recommendation: Enhance verify_url_patterns.py to auto-discover view-to-module mappings instead of hardcoding
recommendations.rationale: Reduces maintenance burden and prevents script becoming stale when views are added/moved

recommendations.recommendation: Integrate verification script into CI/CD pipeline as pre-commit or pre-push hook
recommendations.rationale: Catches URL pattern misconfigurations early in development cycle

recommendations.recommendation: Add docstrings to each view function documenting its URL route and purpose
recommendations.rationale: Improves code discoverability and maintains documentation alongside implementation

recommendations.recommendation: Create unit tests for URL resolution that complement static analysis
recommendations.rationale: Provides runtime validation when Django environment becomes available

recommendations.recommendation: Consider grouping related URL patterns in a centralized configuration
recommendations.rationale: Makes URL structure more visible and easier to understand at a glance
